title: Jallikattu
body:
# 🐂 Jallikattu

**Jallikattu** is a Minecraft minigame where Players must approach wild ravagers with the correct food item, mount them, tame them by successfully pressing the correct keys in sequence.!

---

## 🎮 Gameplay

- Wild **Ravagers** spawn in the arena, each requiring a specific food item to mount
- Hold the **correct food** in your hand and right-click the ravager to get on
- Once mounted, a **taming challenge** begins — switch to the correct hotbar slots in the right order before time runs out
- The player with the most successful tames takes the crown!

---

## ⚙️ Features

- ✔ **Easy-to-setup** - create, set boundaries of the arena, set spawn points and play! (you need to build an arena yourself though :p)
- 🏟️ **Multi-arena support** — create and manage as many arenas as you need
- 🌊 **Wave system** — configurable number of waves per match
- ⚔️ **Three difficulty modes** — Easy, Medium, and Hard, each with unique settings
- 👥 **Multiplayer** — compete against other players for the most tames
- 🔧 **Fully configurable** — tweak ravager count, keypress timing, nausea levels, player limits and more via `config.yml`

---

## 🛠️ Admin Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/jk create <name>` | Create a new arena |
| `/jk info <arena>` | View arena setup status |
| `/jk setspawn <arena>` | Set the player spawn point |
| `/jk setravager <arena>` | Set the ravager spawn point |
| `/jk setlobby <arena>` | Set the player lobby point |
| `/jk pos1 <arena>` | Set first corner of arena boundary |
| `/jk pos2 <arena>` | Set second corner of arena boundary |
| `/jk setdifficulty <arena> <easy/medium/hard>` | Set arena difficulty |
| `/jk enable/disable <arena>` | Enable or disable an arena |
| `/jk start <arena>` | Force start a match |
| `/jk end <arena>` | Force end a match |
| `/jk delete <arena>` | Delete an arena |
| `/jk reload` | Reload the config |

---

## 🛠️ Player Commands
| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/jk join <arena>` | Join an arena |
| `/jk leave` | Leave your current arena |
| `/jk list` | List all arenas |

---

## 🔑 Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `jallikattu.admin` | Access to all admin commands | OP |
| `jallikattu.play` | Ability to join games | Everyone |

---

## 📋 Requirements

- **Spigot / Paper** 1.21+
- **Java** 21+
